document_text:
REPUBLIC OF FRANCE
PASSEPORT / PASSPORT
[STAIN OCCLUSION: ~30% of MRZ line 1 illegible]
Nom / Surname: MAR[STAIN]IN
Prénoms / Given Names: PIERRE [STAIN]QUES
Nationalité / Nationality: FRANÇAISE / FRENCH
Date de naissance / Date of birth: [ILLEGIBLE]
Sexe / Sex: M
Lieu de naissance / Place of birth: PARIS
Date de délivrance / Date of issue: 15.03.2022
Date d'expiration / Date of expiry: 14.03.2032
Autorité / Authority: PRÉFECTURE DE PARIS

MRZ LINE 1: P<FRAMAR[STAIN]IN<<PIERRE<<[STAIN]ES<<<<<<<<<<<<<<
MRZ LINE 2: AB12345[STAIN]6FRA8[STAIN]01[STAIN]5M320314[STAIN]<<<<<<<<<<<<<4
why_adversarial: A coffee or liquid stain occludes approximately 30% of both MRZ lines and obscures the holder's surname and date of birth. The classifier must still identify this as PASSPORT_TD3 from the visible layout cues (P< prefix fragment, booklet structure, issuing authority format, PASSEPORT header) despite MRZ check-digit corruption and partial name loss. A weak classifier will fall back to UNKNOWN because of low MRZ confidence. The confidence band should be moderate (0.50-0.79) triggering GPT-4o escalation per the threshold rule.
classifier_failure_mode: Classifier assigns UNKNOWN due to corrupted MRZ rather than using visual-side layout cues. Or classifier over-confidently assigns PASSPORT_TD3 at high confidence (≥0.80) despite signal loss — both are wrong.
gold_signals_expected: PASSEPORT/PASSPORT bilingual header consistent with TD3 booklet
P< prefix visible in corrupted MRZ line 1
Issuing authority format matches French préfecture pattern
Nom/Prénoms label structure matches French passport visual side
notes: Confidence MUST be below 0.80 to trigger escalation. The agent MUST NOT emit surname or DOB fields — those come from the MRZ parser (C1-02) and are corrupted here. The signals array must cite the surviving layout cues, not the occluded MRZ data.
